video_title: SIXERS: ESPN's Dave McMenamin On How the 76ers Landed LeBron James, And How They Will Make This WORK

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's historic back-to-back MVP achievement in two conferences
quotes.excerpt: the only guy ever to win back-to-back MVPs in two different conferences in NBA history is Moses Malone
quotes.quote: You have to go back to 43 years ago, the guy who came after winning an MVP in Houston, the only guy ever to win back-to-back MVPs in two different conferences in NBA history is Moses Malone, who just so happened to be spending time with LeBron James the day of his first NBA game, getting lunch with him in Sacramento. That is some heady stuff, some stuff from sparkle dust in the universe there.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James brings championship experience and organization to the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: he has more experience than any other player in league history quite literally
quotes.quote: He is going to give those guys some organization. This is not meant to be any sort of shot at the coaching staff or the front office, just he has more experience than any other player in league history quite literally. Four championships, 10 trips to the finals. Stuff like championship habits, guys recognizing the time he puts in, the type of skill work he does, how he manages his schedule, how he balances family and business opportunities and basketball while still watching as much film as anybody else, that is all going to pay off.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers remained consistent throughout the LeBron James recruitment process
quotes.excerpt: the Sixers never fell off. And there was less talk about Minnesota, Denver, and Golden State
quotes.quote: As I continued to report on the story for the 24 days that we had to wait for the answer, the Sixers never fell off. And there was less talk about Minnesota, Denver, and Golden State, and the Sixers remained in the conversation along with obviously Miami and Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers must prioritize sacrifice to integrate their star players
quotes.excerpt: we need to pound home from our very first meeting sacrifice
quotes.quote: I was talking to a member of the Sixers front office today and he said, we need to pound home from our very first meeting sacrifice. And it is going to be everybody is going to need to sacrifice. You look at the usage percentages, I think Joel, Jaylen Brown, and Tyrese all ranked in the top 25 in usage. That cannot continue. There is going to have to be a pecking order. How is it going to look for a guy like P.J. Tucker who very much should be wanting more as he is carving out his career?

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's established relationship with LeBron James helped the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey worked out with LeBron James today in Los Angeles
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey worked out with LeBron James today in Los Angeles and so that has been a strong relationship for four or five years now. I have reported that Maxey is not just one of LeBron's favorite players in the league, but one of his favorite people. And so he was certainly instrumental in giving LeBron someone he already had a pre-established friendship with. I am told Joel had several extensive conversations with LeBron. And the only coach of all the teams he was considering that LeBron had any interaction with prior to the decision was Nick Nurse.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's move to the 76ers was contingent on Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James isn't going to the Sixers if Jaylen Brown wasn't on the Sixers
quotes.quote: Obviously now we look at it, it is basically a package deal. LeBron James isn't going to the Sixers if Jaylen Brown wasn't on the Sixers. So did Boston recognize they were going to create a monster like this? Of course not. I don't think so.
